Why we fix the price first

Most workshops quote after they open the bike up, and the bill grows with every part they find. We look the bike over with you at the counter, agree the work and write the price on its tag, so the number you see on Tuesday is the number you pay on Saturday.

If we find something else while the bike is on the stand, we send you a photograph and a price and wait for a yes before we touch it. Nothing is added without your word, and nothing is left half done because a part is late from the supplier.
